title: Satellite Orbits
description: Each job has its orbit. A weather satellite flies over the poles in a sun-synchronous orbit, crossing every place at the same time of day. A relay sits in geostationary orbit, where the period is one sidereal day and it hangs over one spot, at 42,164 km from Earth's centre. A solar monitor waits at the Lagrange point L1, 1.5 million km sunward, where it sees a storm leave the Sun an hour before it arrives. Unlocks the Weather, Solar Monitor and Relay Satellites, launched by the Rocket Assembly.

puzzle.goal: A circular orbit about a body of gravitational parameter μ has period T. From gravity providing the centripetal force, write its radius r.
puzzle.name: Orbit radius
puzzle.ask: Find r in km for μ = 398600 km³/s² and T = @{T} s (a sidereal day is 86164 s).
puzzle.method: μ/r² = ω²r with ω = 2π/T: so r³ = μT²/4π².
